coordinate_vocabulary.structural_coordinate: Named algebraic position b0 through b8 in a full ASH State Vector.
coordinate_vocabulary.coordinate_index: Zero-based integer index of a Structural Coordinate.
coordinate_vocabulary.ordinal: One-based integer equal to coordinate_index plus one for this profile mapping.
coordinate_vocabulary.presentation_label: Human-readable realm label; it does not determine structure or identity.
coordinate_vocabulary.state_identity: Complete deterministic nine-bit ASH state signature.
coordinate_vocabulary.identity_rule: No Structural Coordinate, Coordinate Index, Ordinal, or presentation label is a complete State Identity.
